d: An unmissable New-York- based “dramedy” in the vein of Woody Allen. Stage manager Rachel (Hannah Pearl Utt) is the only thing standing between her family and utter chaos. She then discovers that her presumed-dead mother (Judith Light: Transparent) is alive and thriving as a soap-opera star!
A man who dumps his long-time girlfriend discovers his ex is a superhero, and she's out for revenge.

“What is it about dogs that brings us so much joy?”  Lives are about to change forever, when human and canine paths intertwine in sunny Los Angeles. There's Elizabeth, a news anchor in her 30's, who not only having to deal with a bad breakup, is struggling to cheer up her depressed dog Sam.

Lauren Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all romantic relationships in order to prevent heartache.
When both of their engagement proposals are a bust, hopeless romantics Margot (Emma Roberts) and Griffin (Thomas Mann) find themselves together on New Year's Eve after a bout of fateful events.
